tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated to the Magento admin shipments grid, logged in, dismissed a blocking popup, applied multiple filters, exported results as CSV, executed a mass-action (PDF Packingslips), opened a shipment View page and clicked Print. The session captured stable element hashes for the controls used and robust XPath/CSS selector patterns for fallback.

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable, deterministic tool that reproduces the core demo: apply shipment grid filters, export results, perform a mass-action (PDF packingslips or print labels), open a shipment view, and click Print. The tool must use stable element references captured from the session and expose the filter/mass-action/export options as parameters.

Action Plan (detailed):
1) Navigate to /admin/sales_shipment/ (assumes authenticated admin session).
2) Fill filters (Shipment #, Order #, Ship-to, Total Qty from/to) using deterministic element hashes captured in-session.
3) Click Search to apply filters and wait for the grid to refresh.
4) Optionally select an export format and click Export to trigger download/navigation.
5) Optionally select a mass-action option and click Submit to run mass actions like 'PDF Packingslips'.
6) Extract the grid content to capture view links and shipment_id values for verification.
7) Open a shipment's View page (agentic step supports choosing a specific row by Shipment # or default recorded link) and extract view page elements.
8) Click Print on the view page to demonstrate per-shipment printing.

Variable Identification (inputs required):
- shipment_number: user-supplied increment id text for Shipment # filter (optional).
- order_number: user-supplied increment id text for Order # filter (optional).
- ship_to_name: user-supplied recipient name for the Ship to Name filter (optional).
- total_qty_from / total_qty_to: numeric strings for Total Qty range filter (optional).
- export_format: selects CSV/Excel/XML from the Export control (optional). If omitted, export is skipped.
- massaction_option: choose 'PDF Packingslips' or 'Print Shipping Labels' (optional). If omitted, mass-action is skipped.
- open_view_using_row: optional shipment increment id to instruct the agentic step to open a specific row's View link.

Step Optimization and Selector Decisions:
- Where possible the tool uses deterministic elementHash values captured during the demonstrative session. These hashes map to unique elements in the recorded DOM and avoid brittle class-only selectors.
- For steps where the recorded elementHash may not exist in a different session (different row counts or UI changes), an agentic step is included to locate a row by visible Shipment # text and click its View link. This addresses dynamic content and ensures robustness across datasets.
- Navigation is kept explicit (direct URL) to avoid unnecessary UI menu clicks. The tool assumes authentication is already present in the browser context and does not perform login steps.
- Wait steps are included after filter/apply/export/mass-action interactions to allow the server to respond and to reduce flakiness.
- The tool intentionally does not attempt to reconstruct Magento's encoded filter payload in the URL. It replays UI interactions (fill inputs and click Search) so it works for POST/JS-driven grids and keeps CSRF handling native to the page.

Notes on stability:
- The elementHash values used are from a recorded successful run and have high reliability in the same UI version/environment. If the site theme or DOM structure changes significantly, the agentic step will locate the View link by matching Shipment # text and parse the href for shipment_id.
- Export/mass-action steps rely on visible select/button controls captured in the session. If export or massaction controls are absent in a future environment, the relevant step will be a no-op or the agentic step can be extended to locate alternative controls using the XPath patterns collected during recording.

This tool is single-purpose (manage shipments grid: filter, export, mass-action, view & print) and deterministic where possible while providing an agentic fallback for dynamic row selection.
name: magento_shipments_grid_actions_v9
description: Automates the Magento admin Shipments grid: apply filters (Shipment #, Order #, Ship-to, Total Qty range), run Export (CSV/Excel/XML), perform mass-action (PDF Packingslips / Print Shipping Labels) and open a shipment View page and click Print. Uses the deterministic element hashes captured during a recorded session to reliably target controls. Assumes an authenticated admin session is already available in the browser context.

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento admin Shipments grid.
Enter the Shipment # filter (leave blank to skip).
Enter the Order # filter (leave blank to skip).
Enter the Ship to Name filter (leave blank to skip).
Enter the Total Qty 'From' filter (leave blank to skip).
Enter the Total Qty 'To' filter (leave blank to skip).
Click the 'Search' / Apply Filters button to refresh the grid with the provided filters.
Allow the grid to refresh after applying filters.
Select the Export format from the 'Export to' dropdown. If '{export_format}' is empty or not provided, this step will select nothing (no-op).
Click the Export button to trigger export. If export_format was not provided, the Export button may perform a default action or be a no-op.
Brief pause to allow the export action to initiate (file download or navigation).
Choose the mass-action option (e.g., 'PDF Packingslips'). If '{massaction_option}' is empty, this will be a no-op and mass-action will not proceed.
Click the mass-action Submit button to apply the selected mass-action. Requires massaction_option to be set.
Pause to allow mass-action request to be submitted and the server to respond (downloads or background jobs may start).
Extract the grid contents and any view link hrefs after filtering / mass-action.
steps.goal: Capture the filtered grid rows and the View link href(s) so the tool can verify results and obtain shipment_id(s).

steps.description: Agentic step to choose the correct row to open when multiple rows may be present or when the demo's View link elementHash doesn't match the current result set.
steps.task: If an explicit {open_view_using_row} value is provided, locate the grid row whose Shipment # cell equals {open_view_using_row} and click its 'View' link. Otherwise click the recorded View link element captured during demo (elementHash '8148a9f063').

steps.description: Click the 'View' link for the (recorded) shipment row to open the Shipment View page. If the previous agent step clicked a different link, this click will target the recorded element as a fallback.
Wait for the Shipment View page to load.
Extract key elements on the shipment view page (header, Print/Create Shipping Label/Send Tracking controls).
steps.goal: Capture the Shipment View page header, any print/download links and tracking/label controls for verification.

steps.description: Click the 'Print' button on the shipment view page to demonstrate per-shipment printing (opens print window or triggers PDF).
Allow print action to begin (PDF or print dialog).

input_schema.name: shipment_number
input_schema.description: Exact shipment increment id to enter into the 'Shipment #' filter (e.g. '100000032'). Leave empty to skip filling this filter.

input_schema.name: order_number
input_schema.description: Exact order increment id to enter into the 'Order #' filter (e.g. '100000199'). Leave empty to skip filling this filter.

input_schema.name: ship_to_name
input_schema.description: Ship-to name to enter into the 'Ship to Name' filter (e.g. 'Jane Doe'). Leave empty to skip filling this filter.

input_schema.name: total_qty_from
input_schema.description: Minimum 'Total Qty' value for the grid range filter (enter numeric string like '1'). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: total_qty_to
input_schema.description: Maximum 'Total Qty' value for the grid range filter (enter numeric string like '1'). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to select from the 'Export to' control. If empty, export step will be skipped.

input_schema.name: massaction_option
input_schema.description: Mass-action option to select from the Actions dropdown. If empty, mass-action will be skipped.

input_schema.name: open_view_using_row
input_schema.description: If provided, opens the View link for the grid row matching this Shipment # (increment id). If empty the recorded View link captured during demo will be clicked.
